description: This file defines a suite of smoke tests for the OnboardingView in a SwiftUI-based macOS application. It includes tests for view construction, page order logic, and remote gateway selection behavior.

classes.name: OnboardingViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A suite of tests for verifying the behavior and UI of the OnboardingView component.

methods.name: `onboarding view builds body`
methods.description: Tests that the onboarding view can be instantiated and its body property accessed.

methods.name: `page order omits workspace and identity steps`
methods.description: Verifies that certain steps are omitted from the onboarding flow under specific conditions.

methods.name: `page order omits onboarding chat when identity known`
methods.description: Ensures the chat step is skipped if identity information is already known.

methods.name: `select remote gateway clears stale ssh target when endpoint unresolved`
methods.description: Checks that selecting a gateway clears an existing SSH target when the endpoint isn't resolved.
